name: Wahra Rentals & Bookings
author: wahra

sections.description:
Wahra Rentals & Bookings transforms your Dokan multi-vendor marketplace into a powerful rental platform. Perfect for equipment rentals, vehicle rentals, property rentals, and more.

Key Features

  • Mobile-First Wizard – Intuitive step-by-step product creation for vendors
  • Advanced Pricing Engine – Daily, weekly, monthly rates with seasonal pricing
  • Availability Management – Calendar-based availability with blackout dates
  • Security Deposits – Configurable deposit handling and refunds
  • Multi-Step Payments – Support for deposit + balance payment workflows
  • Real-Time Availability – Instant availability checking with hold system
  • Email Notifications – Automated emails for bookings, reminders, and confirmations
  • Dokan Integration – Seamless integration with Dokan vendor dashboard

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • Dokan Lite 3.0 or higher (Dokan Pro recommended)
  • PHP 8.1 or higher

Documentation

For detailed documentation, visit wahra.tn

Source Code

The JavaScript files in assets/js/ are compiled from React source code using Vite.

Build from source:

  1. Navigate to the app/ directory
  2. Run npm install to install dependencies
  3. Run npm run build to compile assets

Source code is available at: https://github.com/wahra-tn/wahra-rentals-bookings

Third-party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

  • FullCalendar – Calendar UI component (MIT License)
  • Flatpickr – Date picker (MIT License)
  • Chart.js – Analytics charts (MIT License)
  • International Telephone Input – Phone input formatting (MIT License)
  • Font Awesome – Icons (Font Awesome Free License)
  • React – UI framework (MIT License)
  • Material UI – UI components (MIT License)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/wahra-rentals-bookings/ or install through WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce and Dokan are installed and activated
  4. Configure the plugin settings in Dokan Dashboard > Rentals Settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Dokan Lite?

Yes, the plugin works with both Dokan Lite and Dokan Pro. However, some advanced features may require Dokan Pro.

Can vendors set their own pricing rules?

Yes, vendors have full control over their pricing including daily rates, weekly discounts, seasonal pricing, and more.

How does the availability system work?

The plugin uses a real-time availability index with a hold system to prevent double bookings. Vendors can set blackout dates and manage their calendar.

Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

1.0.2

  • Fix: Renamed plugin prefix from DRB to WAHRB (4+ characters) for WordPress.org compliance
  • Fix: Renamed main plugin file to wahra-rentals-bookings.php
  • Fix: Removed load_plugin_textdomain (WordPress.org handles translations automatically)
  • Fix: Moved all inline scripts to wp_add_inline_script()
  • Fix: Improved input sanitization (wp_unslash, map_deep, sanitize_text_field on session data)
  • Fix: Improved output escaping (wp_kses, wp_strip_all_tags on inline CSS)
  • Fix: Added $wpdb->prepare() to all LIKE queries
  • Fix: Added phpcs:ignore annotations to direct database queries
  • Fix: Fixed mixed line endings in template files
  • Fix: Removed unnecessary development files from distribution
  • Fix: Added source code documentation in readme.txt
  • Fix: Updated third-party libraries to latest versions
  • Fix: Translated remaining hardcoded French strings

1.0.1

  • Fix: Enhanced security with improved nonce verification and output escaping
  • Fix: Standardized date handling for better timezone support
  • Fix: Optimized SQL queries and database interactions
  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and performance improvements

  • Availability management system
  • Security deposit handling
  • Multi-step payment support
  • Email notification system
  • Dokan dashboard integration
